name: Output Kit
tagline: Copy-paste templates for decks, reports, pages, email, social, motion, diagrams and AI interfaces, all on one design system.
author: Frederik

categories.label: Decks
categories.blurb: 16:9 slides that scale with their container: consulting storylines and exhibits, pitch, keynote and workshop slides, and complete decks.

categories.label: Reports
categories.blurb: Blocks for memos, briefings, board packs and printable reports.

categories.label: Page sections
categories.blurb: Heroes, feature grids, pricing, FAQ, footers and device mockups for HTML pages.

categories.label: Email
categories.blurb: Table-based email blocks and signatures. Copying resolves tokens to plain values, because email clients ignore CSS variables.

categories.label: Social
categories.blurb: 4:5 carousel slides and post cards with a hand-annotation kit.

categories.label: Motion
categories.blurb: Animated numbers, charts, text and overlays in CSS and vanilla JS.

categories.label: Interactive
categories.blurb: Buttons, tabs, toggles, dialogs, toasts and other controls.

categories.label: Forms and tools
categories.blurb: Wizards, calculators, decision boards and feedback tools that keep their state in the browser.

categories.label: Data viz
categories.blurb: Dependency-free SVG charts that read their colours from the series tokens.

categories.label: Diagrams
categories.blurb: Flowcharts, sequences, architectures and maps drawn in SVG on the semantic colour pairs.

categories.label: AI interfaces
categories.blurb: Chat threads, prompt composers, streaming answers and tool calls.

categories.label: Backgrounds
categories.blurb: Animated and static backgrounds for heroes, slides and video frames.
